evidence_levels.nonzero_applied_cost_input: Nonzero KV delta supplied to the online scheduler; count is separate from action flips
evidence_levels.single_step_replay: Same-time replay using complete persisted episode and past wait-window evidence; coverage is a subset

single_step_replay.unreplayed_reason: Complete past episode release/holding state unavailable in final snapshots
single_step_replay.causal_scope: Same frozen state and historical observations at one decision time; excludes future trajectory feedback and paired-policy causal action flips

zero_delta_support_scope: Cohort first-loss statistics cover observed nonterminal completion-to-next-request windows; worker-wide BlockRemoved events are separately retained.
